Package bakerydms

Class DailyReport

  • java.lang.Object
    • bakerydms.DailyReport
  • public class DailyReport
extends java.lang.Object
    The result of the custom action, the Daily Production Report.

    For one pickup date the report holds how many cakes of each type the baker must make and how much money the bakery expects to take in. Only orders that have not been picked up are counted. A report is created by OrderManager.generateDailyReport(java.time.LocalDate) and shown by BakeryOrderWindow. Once created it cannot be changed.

    Example: if 10 cakes are due with a subtotal of $265.00 and a 7% tax rate, getTax() returns 18.55 and getExpectedRevenue() returns 283.55.

    Version:
    4.0 (Phase 4, Module 11)
    Author:
    Kayla Ewing
